project-overview.description: Project purpose, detected profile, languages, frameworks, and quick orientation.

repository-map.description: Important manifests, source files, routes, APIs, configs, docs, and agent instruction files.

system-architecture.description: Inferred runtime architecture, service boundaries, deployment hints, and uncertainty labels.

development-workflow.description: Detected build, test, install, and local workflow commands.

api-interfaces.description: Detected API, route, and interface files that define external or internal contracts.

data-storage.description: Detected database, migration, persistence, and storage hints.

security-config.description: Environment variable names, configuration files, agent safety rules, and secret-handling notes.

testing-quality.description: Testing commands, quality gates, validation strategy, and generated-artifact boundaries.

known-issues.description: Unreadable files, TODO markers, placeholders, and scanner-discovered risks.

agent-guidelines.description: How AI agents should use the memory system before editing the repository.

agent-worklog.description: How agents record sessions, checkpoints, execution notes, and handoffs across tools.

repository-graph.description: Full dependency graph, call graph, layer map, health score (A–F), patterns, and security issues. Primary machine-readable source for relationship intelligence. Generated by: agent-memory graph build.

architecture-flow.description: Human+agent readable architectural narrative: entry points, high-coupling files, critical execution paths, layer violations, and dead code. Generated from repository-graph.json.

breaking-changes.description: API surface diff between the last two graph snapshots. Contains removed exports, signature changes, blast radius per changed file, and severity ratings. Generated by: agent-memory graph diff.

dependency-impact.description: Agent-readable impact report generated when breaking changes are detected. Lists breaking changes, affected files, and blast radius tables.

cross-repo-links.description: Cross-repository dependency graph. Maps linked repositories, shared packages, upstream/downstream relationships, and breaking risk ratings.
